title: Does alkaline-phosphatase–GGT coupling add inflammation-marker information beyond nonlinear routine analytes? An exploratory recruitment-wave transfer test
abstract: A logALP × logGGT product did not establish improved contemporaneous logCRP prediction beyond nonlinear routine analytes in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer (5,183 source; 4,673 target adults): weighted MSE difference 0.001388 log(mg/L)², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.002288, 0.010144].
